#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    string input_str;
    getline(cin, input_str);

    // Replace 'dot' with '.' in the middle of the string
    string intermediate = "";
    if (input_str.size() >= 2) {
        intermediate += input_str[0];
        for (size_t i = 1; i + 1 < input_str.size(); ++i) {
            if (i + 3 <= input_str.size() && input_str.substr(i, 3) == "dot") {
                intermediate += '.';
                i += 2; // Skip the next two characters as they are part of 'dot'
            } else {
                intermediate += input_str[i];
            }
        }
        intermediate += input_str.back();
    } else {
        intermediate = input_str;
    }

    // Replace first occurrence of 'at' with '@'
    size_t pos = intermediate.find("at");
    if (pos != string::npos) {
        intermediate.replace(pos, 2, "@");
    }

    cout << intermediate << "\n";

    return 0;
}
